Subject: DPIA & contract annex: processing description and transfer evidence for BancNord pilot

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we discussed, BancNord is preparing a short pilot (UK retail fraud-scoring service) and our internal compliance team needs: 1) a concise processing description suitable for our DPIA appendix, 2) a current subprocessor inventory with country locations and SCC/legal basis notes, and 3) an outline of the cross-border transfer safeguards (Art. 28/30 evidence we can attach to our DPIA).

We also need to confirm whether Redwood will accept an on-site audit or if a remote, role-based evidence handover is preferred (our procurement team is OK with either but needs confirmation).

Can you share a doc we can attach to our DPIA and a short timeline for delivery? Ideally by the end of next week.

— Sarah

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear list. We can definitely support this for the pilot. Action plan:

- Kimberly (Legal) will prepare an Annex describing the processing activities and include the Art. 28/30 references.
- Marissa (Privacy) will produce a short DPIA summary and the subprocessor inventory with country locations and transfer mechanism notes.
- I will coordinate the delivery of a transfer safeguards summary (SCCs, SCC+clauses, and our standard data flow diagram) and confirm audit options.

We can get a preliminary package to you by Thu 23 Sep (EOD UTC) — will that work? If you need anything earlier (e.g., a one-page processing statement for the DPIA), we can send that by Mon 20 Sep.

Regarding audit: Redwood typically supports remote evidence handovers and role-based walkthroughs. We do offer on-site audits in rare cases under an SOW; I will flag that to procurement.

Next step: can you confirm the exact data fields involved in the pilot (PII, hashed identifiers, logs, etc.) and whether you consider model outputs to be personal data for this use? That will help us scope the DPIA appendix.

Best,
Mateo

Redwood Inference

Attached is the initial package for your DPIA and contract annex: a one-page DPIA summary, a detailed processing description suitable for Art. 28/30, the current subprocessor inventory (CSV), and a data-flow diagram for the pilot.

What we included:
- redwood-dpia-summary.pdf — one page, risk controls and retention notes

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the pilot data fields and whether model outputs are considered personal data for your DPIA.
2) Tell us which package you want attached to the DPIA (the one-page summary vs. the full Annex).
3) If you want the walkthrough, propose two 30–60 minute windows next week and we will confirm.

Thanks — happy to iterate quickly.

Best regards,
Mateo Alvarez
